name: Gwenis Dunmore
features: BLOOD HUNTER 3 (Alternate, laserllama v2.2; Banked of Okton's order). Rite Die d4, Rite save DC 13
Hunter's Bane: Occult Lore (Nature); Sinister Insight (bonus action, CON check, DC 8+CR)
Blood Rites known: Revelation, Siphoning (each free once per rest, then Vital Sacrifice)
Crimson Offering (bonus action + Vital Sacrifice; 1 hour; Rite Die extra damage)
Vital Sacrifice: lose current and max HP equal to the Rite Die until a long rest
Order of the Pale Moon: Feral Senses; Lycanthropic Curse (Crow, CR 0); Hybrid Form
Banked: advantage on saves against losing control of the burn; can bleed the heat off with a Vital Sacrifice (drops one stage for 24 hours)
notes: Age 29, female. Pre-conversion level 3. Rank: Raw (converted day 3). Lean, sharp-eyed, a long braid and a hunter's stillness. Came back from the rage in one clear moment and remembers all of it. Guilty over the roc's blood. Feels Okton like a banked fire in the next room. Sister Kita.
